title: 第28章 不是你死就是我亡
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
萧易寒没有回答顾念念的问题。

    他只是牵着顾念念的手，带着她慢慢地穿过了花海，走过一片郁郁葱葱的青草地，最后停在了一处山谷。

    顾念念左右环顾，实在是看不出这里有什么特别的。

    “洛师兄说，天渊秘境到处都是灵草，为何我们走了这么久，一株都没遇上。”

    萧易寒掀唇轻笑。

    “小师叔天渊秘境开启万年，先后进入过无数修士，光是青云宗的记录就有厚厚几摞。为何至今秘境仍有很多区域属于待探索？”

    顾念念眼睛一亮。

    “我知道，因为天渊秘境有时间限定，每次进入不得超过七天，七天后不管我们在干什么，都会被秘境弹出去。”

    萧易寒听后哈哈大笑。

    顾念念嘟嘴，有些不满。

    “这次出发时，大长老说了好几遍，你笑什么！”

    萧易寒勉强止笑声，低头看向顾念念。

    “那如果我跟小师叔说，天渊秘境我早已来过无数次呢？”

    顾念念吃惊地张大了嘴。

    “无数次？你……”

    她本来想说这里没有秘境令牌根本进不来。

    可又想起他是古魔，而且就在不久前他还告诉她，这个天渊秘境根本不是人修大佬的陨落地，更不是飞升大佬开辟的芥子空间，而是另一个古魔的陨落地。

    那……似乎作为同类，能随意进入，也不是不可能。

    “那你来了那么多次，你知道这里是哪里吗？”

    萧易寒轻轻摇头，他的目光缓缓看向四周。

    “这里我只来过一次，可是那一次，也只是刚到了这里，就被弹出去了。”

    顾念念先是一愣，随后捂住嘴巴就笑了。

    “原来你也会被弹出去啊，我还以为会有例外呢。”

    萧易寒也笑了。

    “是啊，我也不是例外。”

    就不知道我的小师叔会不会是那个例外了。

    “走吧，带你去探险。”

    顾念念没有挣脱他的手，由着他牵着。

    只是，先前的那个问题，她并没有放弃。

    “萧易寒，这里还有很多这样的地方吗？”

    萧易寒知道她问的是什么。

    “嗯，天渊秘境很大，大到几万年人类修士对它的探索不足一半。”

    顾念念咂舌。

    那确实很大了。

    “那，你知道这里为何只允许练气境修士进入吗？还有，既然是古魔的陨落地，为何这里的灵气如此纯净？一点魔气也没有。”
content_en:
Xiao Yihan did not answer Gu Niannian's question.

    He just held Gu Niannian's hand and led her slowly through the sea of ​​flowers, through a lush green grassland, and finally stopped in a valley.

    Gu Niannian looked around and couldn't see anything special here.

    "Senior Brother Luo said that there are spiritual herbs everywhere in the Tianyuan Secret Realm. Why have we walked for so long without encountering any of them?"

    Xiao Yihan lifted his lips and smiled softly.

    "My uncle Tianyuan's secret realm has been open for thousands of years, and countless monks have entered it. There are several thick stacks of records from the Qingyun Sect alone. Why are there still many areas in the secret realm that need to be explored?"

    Gu Niannian's eyes lit up.

    "I know, because the Tianyuan Secret Realm has a time limit, and each entry cannot exceed seven days. After seven days, no matter what we are doing, we will be ejected from the secret realm."

    Xiao Yihan laughed loudly after hearing this.

    Gu Niannian pouted, a little dissatisfied.

    "When we set out this time, the Great Elder said several times, why are you laughing!"

    Xiao Yihan reluctantly stopped laughing and looked down at Gu Niannian.

    "Then what if I tell my junior uncle that I have been to the Tianyuan Secret Realm countless times?"

    Gu Niannian opened her mouth in surprise.

    "Countless times? You..."

    She originally wanted to say that there was no way to get in without a secret realm token.

    But then she remembered that he was an ancient demon, and not long ago he told her that this secret realm of Tianyuan was not the place where the human cultivator fell, let alone the mustard space opened by the ascended boss, but the fall of another ancient demon.

    That... seems like it's not impossible for people of the same kind to be able to enter at will.

    "Then you've been here so many times, do you know where this is?"

    Xiao Yihan shook his head gently, and his eyes slowly looked around.

    "I have only been here once, but that time, I was ejected just after I arrived here."

    Gu Niannian was stunned for a moment, then covered her mouth and laughed.

    "It turns out that you will also be ejected. I thought there would be exceptions."

    Xiao Yihan also laughed.

    "Yeah, I'm not an exception either."

    I don’t know if my junior uncle will be that exception.

    "Let's go, let's take you on an adventure."

    Gu Niannian didn't break away from his hand and let him hold it.

    However, she did not give up on the previous issue.

    "Xiao Yihan, are there many places like this here?"

    Xiao Yihan knew what she was asking.

    "Well, the Tianyuan Secret Realm is so big that human monks have not explored half of it for tens of thousands of years."

    Gu Niannian clicked her tongue.

    That's really big.

    "Then, do you know why only Qi-training monks are allowed to enter here? Also, since this is the place where the ancient demon fell, why is the spiritual energy here so pure? There is no demonic energy at all."
title_en: Chapter 28 Either you die or I die
